verdict.line: You win trades where you E-pull her into point-blank Q before she can unload her combo; you lose if you extend a fight with Indestructible on cooldown and eat a full Q-W-Q-Q string.

brief.thesis: Death's Grasp has 700 range, further than any of Riven's dash abilities, so Mordekaiser can yank her out of a committed Q (275 range) or E (250 range) and punish her with Obliterate's single-target damage bonus before she resets. His W-last skill order (Q>E>W) means early trades lean on that Q/E burst rather than the shield, which only becomes the deciding factor once it's actually up — hence the 50.6% win rate across 1,750 games is a real but modest edge, not a stomp.

theirWindow.when: her Q, W, and E are all up
theirWindow.what: She can full-combo: Ki Burst stun into Broken Wings dashes and empowered Runic Blade autos. Back off from minion range if your own W is also down, since you have no shield to absorb it.

yourWindow.what: She loses her only damage-block and extra gap-closer. Pull her in with E (Death's Grasp) and land Obliterate at point blank for the single-target damage bonus.

start.why: The AP, mana regen, and health let you spam Q/E for poke and still have mana for the E-pull all-in window without falling behind on sustain.

boots.why: Riven's damage leans on empowered Runic Blade autos; the flat reduction on basic attacks blunts her trade pattern more than Mercury's Treads does here.

core.why: The slow from Q and E makes it much harder for her to kite away after Valor or the third Broken Wings hit.
Omnivamp plus the ramping true damage turns extended trades in your favor once Indestructible is also stacking its shield.
Boosts the healing you get from popping your W shield and from Riftmaker's omnivamp, directly countering her burst windows.

situational.when: she's building lifesteal or out-trading you on autos and you need the grievous wounds and early armor
she or her team starts stacking health and you need the burn to shred through it
her team has another hard-CC or burst threat beyond her own stun and dashes

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing rewards exactly the kind of extended, Q/E-into-combat trades this matchup wants, and it pairs with your W shield for even more sustain.

summoners.why: Ignite seals solo kills on an all-in since Riven has no native sustain outside her Runic Blade autos, and Flash lets you reposition for an E-pull or escape if her combo lands first.

playing.title: Hold E for her all-in
playing.detail: Death's Grasp's 700 range outreaches every one of her dashes. Save it to yank her back into Q range the instant she commits Broken Wings or Valor.

playing.title: Trade only with W up
playing.detail: Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can pop to heal. Don't extend a fight without it available.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown window
playing.detail: Valor's cooldown is 10/9/8/7/6s. When it's down she has no damage-block or bonus mobility, so your E-into-Q combo is close to unanswerable.

playing.title: Max Q first for single-target burst
playing.detail: The Q>E>W skill order ranks Obliterate fastest, and its damage is highest against a single target, so look for isolated trades rather than fighting through minions.

playing.title: Watch for charged Runic Blade
playing.detail: Her empowered auto-attacks deal bonus damage off stored charges; if her blade is visibly glowing, expect a harder hit on the next auto and play around it.

playing.title: Use Ignite to close kills
playing.detail: She has no sustain outside her attack damage kit, so Ignite on an all-in denies any late heals or active items and seals the solo kill.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Wind Slash
playing.detail: Her R grants bonus AD and range plus a one-time ranged Wind Slash. Don't sit at low HP near the point she hits level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG, including the small-sample item paths; the tactical reasoning tying them together is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Do not fight Riven if your [W] is on cooldown. Purchase Bramble Vest and maintain your [P] when fighting her.
